<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue';

import { TagGroupRoot, type TagGroupRootEmits, type TagGroupRootProps, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui';

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const delegatedAttrs = computed(() => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(useAttrs()).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
});

const props = defineProps<TagGroupRootProps>();
const emits = defineEmits<TagGroupRootEmits>();
const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits);

defineSlots<{
  /**
   * Tags in the group. Receives the current selection.
   */
  default?: (props: { modelValue: TagGroupRootProps['modelValue'] }) => unknown;
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <TagGroupRoot
    v-slot="slotProps"
    data-slot="tag-group"
    class="sigma-ui-tag-group"
    v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...delegatedAttrs }"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot v-bind="slotProps" />
  </TagGroupRoot>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-tag-group {
  display: flex;
  min-height: 2.5rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0.5rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

.sigma-ui-tag-group[data-disabled] {
  opacity: 0.5;
  pointer-events: none;
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue';

import { TagGroupItem, type TagGroupItemProps, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui';

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const delegatedAttrs = computed(() => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(useAttrs()).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
});

const props = defineProps<TagGroupItemProps>();
const forwarded = useForwardProps(props);

defineSlots<{
  /**
   * Tag content, usually the text and a delete button.
   */
  default?: (props: { selected: boolean; disabled: boolean }) => unknown;
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <TagGroupItem
    v-slot="slotProps"
    data-slot="tag-group-item"
    class="sigma-ui-tag-group-item"
    v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...delegatedAttrs }"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot v-bind="slotProps" />
  </TagGroupItem>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-tag-group-item {
  display: inline-flex;
  height: 1.5rem;
  align-items: center;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background-color: var(--secondary);
  color: var(--secondary-foreground);
}

.sigma-ui-tag-group-item:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.sigma-ui-tag-group-item[data-state="checked"] {
  background-color: var(--primary);
  color: var(--primary-foreground);
}

.sigma-ui-tag-group-item[data-disabled] {
  opacity: 0.5;
  pointer-events: none;
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue';

import { TagGroupItemDelete, type TagGroupItemDeleteProps, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { XIcon } from 'lucide-vue-next';

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const delegatedAttrs = computed(() => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(useAttrs()).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
});

const props = defineProps<TagGroupItemDeleteProps>();
const forwarded = useForwardProps(props);
</script>

<template>
  <TagGroupItemDelete
    data-slot="tag-group-item-delete"
    class="sigma-ui-tag-group-item-delete"
    v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...delegatedAttrs }"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot>
      <XIcon class="sigma-ui-tag-group-item-delete__icon" />
    </slot>
  </TagGroupItemDelete>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-tag-group-item-delete {
  display: inline-flex;
  margin-inline-end: 0.25rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.sigma-ui-tag-group-item-delete:hover {
  background-color: var(--muted);
}

.sigma-ui-tag-group-item-delete[data-disabled] {
  pointer-events: none;
}

.sigma-ui-tag-group-item-delete__icon {
  width: 1rem;
  height: 1rem;
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue';

import { TagGroupItemText, type TagGroupItemTextProps, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui';

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const delegatedAttrs = computed(() => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(useAttrs()).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
});

const props = defineProps<TagGroupItemTextProps>();
const forwarded = useForwardProps(props);

defineSlots<{
  /**
   * Visible label of the tag.
   */
  default?: () => unknown;
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <TagGroupItemText
    data-slot="tag-group-item-text"
    class="sigma-ui-tag-group-item-text"
    v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...delegatedAttrs }"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot />
  </TagGroupItemText>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-tag-group-item-text {
  padding: 0 0.5rem;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
}
</style>
